title: alchemilla alpina var. subsericea
intro: Alchemilla alpina var. subsericea, commonly known as Alpine Lady's Mantle, is a plant species in the Rosaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and support wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Lady's Mantle include astringent, demulcent, and vulnerary properties, making it effective in treating skin conditions, wounds, and ulcers. The bioactive constituents of this plant are believed to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
